extension.summary: Pigeon Build Wizard - Fast Streaming, Zero Buffer
extension.description: The ultimate Kodi build wizard optimized for Fire TV Stick and streaming devices. Features pre-configured add-ons, optimized settings, and everything you need for the perfect streaming experience.
extension.disclaimer: The developers of Pigeon Build do not host, create, or distribute any content. We provide a configuration tool only.
